description: Bootstrap collapse.js v3.3.7 implementation defining the Collapse class for toggleable UI elements.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Class managing the collapse behavior of UI elements, including show, hide, toggle, and event handling.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension ('width' or 'height') used for collapsing.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Expands the collapse element with transition effects.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Collapses the element with transition effects.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent element for grouped collapse behavior.

methods.name: addAriaAndCollapsedClass
methods.description: Updates ARIA attributes and classes based on collapse state.
